name: GatherPress
author: GatherPress

sections.description:
GatherPress is a flexible, community-powered event management plugin for WordPress. Whether you’re organizing a local meetup, global conference, or something entirely your own, GatherPress helps people come together.

💡 Features

  • Event scheduling (date, time, location, description)
  • Attendee registration (with optional anonymous listing)
  • Attendees can bring guests
  • Email notifications for attendees and non-attendees
  • Online and in-person event support (with mapping)
  • Full block editor support
  • Multisite-ready and fully internationalized

👉 See the full feature list
👉 Explore upcoming features

🚀 Quick Start

Install from WordPress.org

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for GatherPress
  3. Click Install, then Activate

Or Install from GitHub

Download the latest .zip from the Releases page, then upload it to your WordPress dashboard under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.

📖 View installation guide
🛠️ View configuration guide

🧪 Try It Instantly

Use our Playground Environment to test GatherPress with real data — no setup required!

📺 Watch the intro demo
🧪 Learn more about Playground

🤝 Get Involved

GatherPress is built by and for the community — contributions are always welcome.

  • 🧠 Read the Developer Docs
  • 🛠️ Check out open issues
  • 💬 Join us on WordPress Slack or GatherPress.org

📖 Contributor Guide

🛠️ Third-Party Libraries

  • Leaflet — interactive maps for venues
  • React-Modal — modal dialogs (currently in use, but being phased out)
  • React-Tooltip — tooltips (currently in use, but being phased out)
